title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Boil spaghetti until al dente. Fry pancetta until crispy. Whisk eggs with Parmesan and pepper. Mix pasta with pancetta, remove from heat, then stir in egg mixture quickly to create a creamy sauce.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato-based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and masala paste. Grill until cooked. Fry onion until soft, add tomatoes and cream. Add chicken, simmer for 10 minutes, then serve.
